title: PerSourceFeed
description: One source's unmerged output, published at /sources/<source_id>.json. A supported public contract, not a pipeline internal.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the source workflow run that produced this file. Distinct from the merge run's timestamp.

source_id.description: Matches the URL path segment and every contained event's source.id.

status.description: Clients must tolerate unrecognized values by treating them as unknown rather than failing to decode.
